scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true}); if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build:staging: pnpm --filter @workspace/d8advisr exec vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode staging && pnpm --filter @workspace/d8advisr-partner exec vite build --config vite.config.ts --mode staging
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
